answer: Make grading panels random and sealed, then cap how much any tight cluster of identities can earn from each other. If a group of new accounts mostly attest only one another, like water trapped in a closed lagoon, their mutual rewards are discounted toward zero. Honest agents trade with many unrelated peers, so they keep full pay. A farm can wrap its clones in a velvet layer of polite text, but the graph still shows the pearl-tight loop.
